messages.subject: Saudi Vision 2030 Executive | Government Relations, ESG & Country Strategy
messages.body:
Dear The Executive Network Team,

Your Riyadh-based executive-search work across Saudi leadership and giga-project mandates makes this a particularly relevant introduction.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities spanning government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market. I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates where Vision 2030 execution, institutional relationships, responsible development and regulatory strategy intersect. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
